meta.name: ad-creative
meta.description: When the user needs to generate, iterate, or scale ad creative for paid advertising. Use when they say 'write ad copy,' 'generate headlines,' 'create ad variations,' 'bulk creative,' 'iterate on ads,' 'ad copy validation,' 'RSA headlines,' 'Meta ad copy,' 'LinkedIn ad,' or 'creative testing.' This is pure creative production — distinct from paid-ads (campaign strategy). Use ad-creative when you need the copy, not the campaign plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成和迭代广告文案与创意变体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为付费广告生成或优化文案和创意。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and iterate ad copy and creative variations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or optimize ad copy and creative for paid advertising.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成广告文案专家，能生成、迭代或批量制作付费广告文案。它会先收集产品、受众、平台等信息，然后按不同流程产出符合平台规范的标题、正文和行动号召。
howto.when: 当你要求“写广告文案”、“生成标题”、“创建广告变体”、“批量创意”、“迭代广告”、“验证广告文案”、“RSA 标题”、“Meta 广告文案”、“LinkedIn 广告”或“创意测试”时触发。

say.text: 帮我写5条Google RSA广告标题，每条不超过30字。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合字数限制的标题并给出固定建议。

say.text: 基于这个获胜广告，迭代3个变体并测试一个新角度。
say.note: Claude 会分析现有文案，生成变体并探索新方向。

say.text: 为我的Meta广告生成3套文案，包括主文本、标题和描述。
say.note: Claude 会产出完整的广告组文案，并标注字符数。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude becomes an ad copy expert that can generate, iterate, or scale paid ad creative. It first gathers context (product, audience, platform), then produces platform-compliant headlines, body copy, and CTAs following different workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'write ad copy,' 'generate headlines,' 'create ad variations,' 'bulk creative,' 'iterate on ads,' 'ad copy validation,' 'RSA headlines,' 'Meta ad copy,' 'LinkedIn ad,' or 'creative testing.'

say_en.text: Write 5 Google RSA headlines, each under 30 characters.
say_en.note: Claude will generate headlines within limits and suggest pinning.

say_en.text: Iterate 3 variations on this winning ad and test a new angle.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze existing copy, generate variations, and explore new angles.

say_en.text: Generate 3 ad sets for Meta with primary text, headline, and description.
say_en.note: Claude will produce complete ad sets with character counts.
